title: The Secret Physics Behind Your Coffee’s Foam

scenes.text: A cup of espresso in Rome creates a crema that defies gravity

scenes.label: CARBON DIOXIDE MICRO‑BUBBLES

scenes.text: The oil coating on coffee beans acts as a surfactant, lowering surface tension and keeping the crema intact
